Use a rain gauge and thermometer only
Burn the mixture until nothing remains
questions.correctAnswer: Use a magnet, add water, filter, then evaporate
questions.explanation: Magnetism removes iron, filtering removes sand, and evaporation recovers dissolved salt.
questions.learningOutcome: Plan a multi-step separation using different material properties.

questions.prompt: Which design makes a simple class circuit safer and easier to control?
options: Cell, bulb, switch, and insulated wires in a complete circuit
Bare wires held in wet hands
A cell connected directly to water
A bulb with no wire path
questions.correctAnswer: Cell, bulb, switch, and insulated wires in a complete circuit
questions.explanation: A switch controls current, insulated wires improve safety, and the complete circuit lights the bulb.
questions.learningOutcome: Design a safe simple electric circuit.

questions.prompt: A class wants to monitor a tree seedling for one month. Which technology plan gives the best evidence?
options: Measure height weekly, take dated photos, and enter results in a table
Look once and guess the final height
Use only a music player near the seedling
Delete all records after each lesson
questions.correctAnswer: Measure height weekly, take dated photos, and enter results in a table
questions.explanation: Regular measurements, dated photos, and a table give clear evidence of change over time.
questions.learningOutcome: Plan technology-supported data collection for a long-term observation.
